synopsis: A legal mystery adventure where the Judge's son uncovers how prosecutor Kaizen swapped a palladium implant for a lethal pure iron tooth to murder Judge Vance inside a 3.0T MRI scanner.

locations.name: Metro Memorial Hospital - MRI Radiology Wing

evidence_dossier.title: State v. Mercer Case File (Kaizen's Motive)
evidence_dossier.summary: Transcript proving Judge Vance disbarred Kaizen Mercer for manufacturing fake testimony in his career-defining case. Kaizen vowed revenge on the public record.

evidence_dossier.title: MRI Ballistics & Iron Analysis
evidence_dossier.summary: Autopsy report confirming the lethal projectile was a 100% pure ferromagnetic iron molar that ripped into the skull at 45 m/s when the 3.0T magnet energized.

evidence_dossier.title: Dr. Aris's Palladium Purchase Invoice
evidence_dossier.summary: Official invoice from Zurich Biomaterials showing Dr. Aris ordered a certified non-magnetic Palladium-100 crown. The clinic never stocked iron.

evidence_dossier.title: Tampered Clinic CCTV Log (4-Min Loop)
evidence_dossier.summary: Security analysis showing internal camera footage was patched into a repeating 4-minute loop between 3:10 and 3:30 AM to mask an unauthorized break-in.

evidence_dossier.title: ATM Surveillance Snapshot (Plate #7X-904)
evidence_dossier.summary: Bank street camera recording of an unmarked black sedan in the clinic alley at 3:15 AM. Plate #7X-904 traced to an abandoned warehouse in the industrial docks.

evidence_dossier.title: The Genuine Palladium Tooth Crown
evidence_dossier.summary: The authentic Swiss palladium-alloy crown crafted for Judge Vance, stamped with Dr. Aris's serial #P-992. Found in the burglar's hideout.

evidence_dossier.title: $250,000 Offshore Wire Transfer Receipt
evidence_dossier.summary: Bank confirmation slip proving $250,000 wired to the deceased burglar from Kaizen Mercer's private legal escrow, with instructions to swap the crown and vanish.
